criteria.title: Usable four-card artifact
criteria.description: The requested Markdown memo exists, is readable, and contains exactly four identifiable, developed research cards.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Pack grounding and traceability
criteria.description: Every card cites valid local IDs, challenges at least one soft or hidden assumption, names a cross-domain mechanism, and grounds the proposal in an observation or available enabler.
evidence_requirements: Inspect the relevant submitted artifact or state and cite the exact file, section, record, or behavior.
Check every substantive clause in this delivery condition against the task and supplied data.
When rejecting a semantic equivalent, explain the substantive difference rather than a label or layout difference.

criteria.title: Structural transfer and assumption transformation
criteria.description: Each direction maps a distant-domain mechanism through causal or relational correspondences, makes a consequential change to the Mosaic problem representation or constraints, and preserves a relevant boundary condition instead of relying on metaphor.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

criteria.title: Falsifiability, discrimination, and feasibility
criteria.description: Each card gives a falsifiable prediction and a small experiment whose controls isolate the proposed mechanism, respects the hard deployment envelope or names a missing dependency, and identifies a specific kill risk with an observable failure signal.
evidence_requirements: Cite the delivered file, section, record, or observable behavior for each substantive clause.
Check the requested task and supplied data for missing or contradictory delivery evidence.
Accept equivalent wording or structure only when the requested outcome remains intact.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
